name: Broken Top Meadow
description: Alpine meadow with a meandering snowmelt stream below Broken Top's red and black jagged summit under clear blue sky

name: Mt. Tallac Sunset
description: Golden sunset from the Mt. Tallac trail with Lake Tahoe gleaming through haze below and Sierra ridgelines layered to the horizon

name: Lone Pine on Tallac
description: Solitary weathered pine standing resilient on the rocky talus slope of Mt. Tallac against deep blue sky

name: Tallac Summit View
description: Panoramic view from Mt. Tallac summit over all of Lake Tahoe with Fallen Leaf Lake below and granite ridges framing the basin

name: Tahoe South Shore
description: Crystal clear Lake Tahoe water at the south shore with golden fall aspens lining the beach and Sierra peaks rising behind

name: Alabama Hills Golden Hour
description: Warm golden-hour light bathes the rounded granite boulders of the Alabama Hills with the snow-dusted Sierra Nevada crest rising behind, a dog exploring at the edge of the frame.

name: Sierra Crest from Alabama Hills
description: Snow-capped Sierra Nevada peaks including Lone Pine Peak and Mt. Whitney tower beyond the weathered granite formations and sage-covered desert floor of the Alabama Hills.

name: Crystal Creek Valley
description: Mountain creek flowing through a lush valley with layered red and green mountainsides in the San Juan Mountains of Colorado

name: San Juan Red Rock Face
description: Towering red rock mountain face covered in evergreen forest with a rocky riverbank in the foreground, San Juan Mountains, Colorado
